cohort: One hundred newborns admitted to NICU and postnatal wards were observed daily for signs of jaundice until five days postpartum or discharge.
finding: Neonatal hyperbilirubinemia can be predicted well by both UCB and BAR, but UCB is a stronger predictor than BAR.
birth_weight: 77% of the cohort had birth weight 2.5-3.5 kg
